transcript.text: returns ka screen chahiye: order chuno, uske items aaye, return create ho

Ek screen banata hoon jahan order chunoge, uske items apne aap aa jayenge, aur wahi se naya return create hoga apne reason aur status ke saath. Shopify ka returns list read-only hai isliye naya return wahan se create nahi ho sakta — yeh apna naya Returns section hoga jo order ke data par chalega. Ek behtar idea: return create karte waqt pehle exchange offer karo, refund sirf customer ke mana karne par, aur reason ek fixed list (size/fit, damaged, wrong item, not as expected, changed mind) se lo — isse pata chalega kaunsa product baar baar wapas aa raha hai. Chahte ho yeh? Aur yeh batao: refund QC pass hone tak rokna hai kya, aur exchange bhi track karna hai ya sirf refund? Banau?

Luke, exchange offer mat add karo abhi. Bas return log karo quickly — order, item, quantity, reason aur status. Bas itna hi. QC wala confusion nahi, sirf Requested, Received, Refund — ye teen status kaafi hain. Aur haan, reason list theek hai tumhara. Simplify rakho, bas ye karo.

Returns ko Shopify ke apne returns list par track karunga, order aur uske items dekhne ke saath, aur unke saath apna internal status rakhunga.
Tumhare Shopify store me returns pehle se maujood hain, to ek naya hand-typed list banane se wo tumhare asli returns se match nahi karega. Isliye Returns section Shopify ke apne returns data par banega — order, customer, item, quantity, reason sab waheen se aayega — aur iske saath ek apna 'internal_status' field hoga (Requested / Received / Refund) jise staff khud badlega jab tak return nipat na jaaye. Orders aur unke items ek screen par dekhne ke liye do chhote reference sections bhi rahenge.
[A design, with a Build button:]
- NEW_MODULE "Orders": Shopify ke orders yahan dikhte hain, taaki return kisi order se jude item dhoondh sake.
  fields: Order [order_number] (text) · Placed [placed_at] (date) · Customer [customer_name] (text) · Phone [customer_phone] (phone) · Total [total] (currency) · Before refunds [total_original] (currency) · Goods [subtotal] (currency) · Shipping [shipping] (currency) · Tax [tax] (currency) · Discount [discount] (currency) · Currency [currency] (text) · Status [status] (badge) · Fulfilment [fulfilment_status] (badge) · Payment [gateway] (badge) · City [ship_city] (text) · State [ship_state] (text) · Discounts [discount_codes] (text)
- NEW_MODULE "Order Items": Har order ke andar kaunse items hain, inhi se return ka item pata chalega.
  fields: Order [order_number] (text) · Placed [placed_at] (date) · Customer [customer_name] (text) · Product [title] (text) · Variant [variant_title] (text) · SKU [sku] (text) · Qty [quantity] (number) · Price [price] (currency) · Line total [line_total] (currency) · Status [status] (badge)
- NEW_MODULE "Returns": Shopify me jo bhi return aata hai, wahi yahan dikhega, order/item/quantity/reason ke saath, aur ek apna Requested/Received/Refund status jisse staff isko aage track karein.
  fields: Return [name] (text) · Order [order_number] (text) · Customer [customer_n
